scope: Tracked repository source, generated-notebook consistency, offline labs, site source, CI workflows, and selected current vendor documentation.

findings.current_behavior: Root and contributor guidance described 17 labs through lab 16 although 20 source/notebook pairs (00-19) exist.
findings.evidence: labs/README.md lists 00-19 and scripts/run_notebooks.py selects every two-digit notebook.
findings.remediation: Updated authoritative overview and contributor instructions to describe 20 labs and the 20/20 offline result.

findings.current_behavior: One guide link targeted an absent templates README; another mislabeled lab 18 as lab 17 and targeted a nonexistent notebook.
findings.evidence: The templates directory has no README; labs are numbered 00-19 and lab 18 is technician_feedback_playbook_learning.
findings.remediation: Linked the templates directory and corrected the lab 18 link and label.

findings.current_behavior: The progress card counted only lesson-pass-k even though the lessons page persists one completion ID for each of 11 lessons.
findings.evidence: The canonical lessons array contains 11 slugs.
findings.remediation: Derived progress IDs from the canonical lessons array.
validation: site build and internal-link check passed

findings.current_behavior: A hidden anchor used an en dash while the rendered Markdown heading and source link normalize it to an ASCII hyphen.
findings.evidence: slugify normalizes punctuation to hyphens, so the source fragment could not resolve on the rendered page.
findings.remediation: Removed the incompatible workaround and added renderer/link-check regression coverage for the canonical normalized anchor.
validation: site build and internal-link check passed

findings.current_behavior: The optional Jev live path reads JEVMODEL_API_KEY but the canonical environment template omitted it.
findings.evidence: The notebook, runner, and Colab generator all name the variable.
findings.remediation: Added an empty JEVMODEL_API_KEY placeholder only; no credential or live call is added.
validation: offline notebook suite removes the variable and completed without live requests

findings.current_behavior: Video source notes cited renamed, nonexistent lab source files.
findings.evidence: Current lab sources use realtime_tools_and_guardrails, turn_taking_and_interruptions, langsmith_tracing_evals, and capstone_talker_thinker names.
findings.remediation: Updated source citations to current lab-source paths.

findings.current_behavior: Video production instructions implied the repository environment contained Manim, Kokoro, Torch, and SoundFile although they are not core requirements.
findings.evidence: The renderer imports Kokoro and SoundFile and invokes Manim and ffmpeg; requirements.txt does not list them.
findings.remediation: Added a separate local video requirements file and explicit ffmpeg preflight.
validation: requirements file and documented command inspected; heavyweight install intentionally not run

findings.current_behavior: Weekly source checking omitted external URLs embedded in site source.
findings.evidence: site/src contains cited vendor, standards, and data-source URLs while the checker scanned Markdown only.
findings.remediation: Extended the existing checker to scan tracked site Astro/TypeScript source while excluding test fixtures and URL-processing implementation code.
validation: expanded checker completed after source-template exclusion and bot-protection policy updates; remaining failures are documented in the audit report

findings.current_behavior: The LiveKit time estimate did not distinguish required validation work and referenced an absent worksheet path; checklist lesson links were GitHub-invalid root-relative URLs.
findings.evidence: Required steps extend the stated guided durations; the worksheet is in voice-agent-architecture.md; root-relative links do not resolve on GitHub project pages.
findings.remediation: Clarified guided versus validation time, linked the actual worksheet, and used the deployed lessons URL.

findings.current_behavior: LiveKit guidance needed current primary-source confirmation.
findings.evidence: LiveKit official Agents documentation retrieved on 2026-10-18 confirms Python/Node SDK support, Agent Builder browser prototyping, and voice quickstart/deployment paths.
findings.remediation: No product change was warranted: existing guidance remains directionally consistent. Record the successful review and retain its explicit model/API verification caveat.

research.claim: Agents supports Python/Node programs and browser-based Agent Builder; voice quickstart and deployment paths remain documented.
research.limitation: Specific SDK snippets are still version-sensitive and require per-upgrade verification. The direct URL is already cataloged in docs/references.md.
